name: Slow Gel Toy
description: A glossy, softly translucent gel stress toy. Squeeze, stretch and release a ball or rounded cube with a slow impression recovery.

assets.credit: Original procedural material rendered from the live effect. Reference recordings and branded artwork are not included.

compatibility: WebGL2, Pointer Events, ResizeObserver and ES modules. Exact Three.js runtime and license are included in the standalone package.
Mouse, touch and keyboard input. Reduced motion begins still; explicit Resume enables animation. Hidden and offscreen work pauses.
Bounded geometry budgets; one renderer per study. A static plate remains available without JavaScript.
notes: An original gel object with a continuously deformed surface, recomputed normals, softly transmitted color and procedural studio reflections. Compression creates lateral bulging; a local grip follows the hand. The skin and highlights respond to the same geometry. This is a controlled toy approximation, not a medical or engineering material model.
Every gesture changes material state. The preview, inspector, presets, PNG capture and complete source export use the same effect.
reuse: Import createGelToy from engine.js and provide a sized canvas, settings and optional frame/error hooks.
Use point(x,y,pressed), release(), update(settings), replay(), setRunning(boolean) and dispose(). Input coordinates are normalized within the canvas.
The exported example runs over a plain local HTTP server. No Tampa routing or external image service is required.
